Entity type Academic / Education

Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform for educational training.
Description

Develop Standard Cubesat Bus. Build, Launch, and Operate Cubesat. Provide opportunity for Native Hawaiian engineering students. Accelerate next-gen mission development.

Notes

Although much work was done on this project over three years, toward a 2011 launch, HSFL offered a workforce development opportunity to integrate existing work into an even larger project. This resulted in the successful assimilation of project personnel and resources into the Hawai`i Space Flight Laboratory's "Hawai`iSat-1 Mission".
